item.title: Isha Malviya says ‘Ishqa’n De Lekhe’ is more than a debut, calls it a dream come true
item.description: A source close to the development revealed that the secrecy is deliberate, as the makers want to unveil the project at the right time. If finalised as planned, the film could mark a significant turning point in Isha’s career.

item.title: Revenue clinics to address people’s problems
item.description: Guntur: Guntur district collector A Thameem Ansariya informed that the Public Grievance Redressal System and revenue clinics will be conducted at the Collectorate here on Monday. She released a statement to this effect on Sunday.She stated that district-level revenue clinics are being conducted to provide speedy solutions to various revenue-related problems faced by the public. item.title: Ankita Lokhande recalls 2016 as toughest chapter of her life, says it broke her completely
item.description: The actress also looked back at personal memories from that time, including her first-ever Instagram post, noting that she has always been deeply connected to her family. She wrote that being a “family girl” has remained constant in her life, then and now.

item.title: Mumbai Mayor Race Heats Up As Shinde Moves Corporators To Hotel Amid Tight BMC Numbers
item.description: The battle for Mumbai mayor intensifies after the BJP–Shinde Sena alliance narrowly crosses the majority mark in BMC polls, triggering political manoeuvring, hotel stays, and sharp exchanges between rivals.

item.title: Pushpa director Sukumar overwhelmed by love from Japan, says cinema has no borders
item.description: The reaction comes in the wake of the successful Japanese release of Pushpa 2: The Rule, which hit theatres in Japan as Pushpa Kunrin on January 16 to packed houses. The film’s lead star Allu Arjun, who travelled to Japan for the release, received an enthusiastic welcome from fans.

item.title: Vivo X200T India Price Leak Hints at Premium Positioning Ahead of Launch
item.description: Vivo X200T price leak reveals premium ambitions in India, with flagship performance, powerful cameras, long software support, and fast charging promise.

item.description: Rosemary water spray vs rosemary oil: Discover which is better for hair growth, benefits, usage tips, and expert advice for stronger, healthier hair.

item.title: Jane Fonda hopes to look back on a ‘good life’ when she reaches her deathbed
item.description: She revealed that regular physical activity remains a key part of her routine, citing long walks, including recently along the Champs-Élysées in Paris, as an example of how she stays active. Fonda stressed that such habits have helped her remain strong and engaged in life, especially as she grows older.

item.title: Cops recover lost bag of valuables and cash within eight hours
item.description: Visakhapatnam: A bag containing valuables worth approximately Rs.1.6 lakh was recovered and returned to its owner within a short span of time.Thanks to the swift and efficient response of the Kancharapalem crime police in Visakhapatnam. The bag was lost when the complainant was travelling by an auto-rickshaw to Visakhapatnam railway station to board a train to Hyderabad. item.title: UP Murder Case: Man Accused Of Killing Live-in Partner, Burning Body In Trunk Goes Absconding
item.description: A retired railway employee in Uttar Pradesh’s Jhansi is accused of murdering his live-in partner, burning her body inside a trunk, and fleeing after a loader driver alerted police to suspicious activity.
